tools.name: list_effects
tools.description: List the available AI photo effects (slug, name, category, description, cover image, credit cost). Free.

tools.name: apply_effect
tools.description: Apply an AI photo effect to a photo and return the result image URL. Waits up to about 60 seconds. Costs 11 credits (standard) or 29 credits (pro); failed jobs are refunded. The photo must show a real person who agreed to the edit.

tools.name: get_effect_task
tools.description: Get the status and result URL of a photo effect task (for long-running or async jobs).

tools.name: face_swap
tools.description: Put the face from the source photo onto the largest face in the target photo and return the result image URL. Costs 5 credits; failed jobs are refunded. Only use photos of people who consented.

tools.name: get_face_swap_result
tools.description: Get the status and result URL of a face swap task.

tools.name: detect_faces
tools.description: Detect faces in a photo with bounding boxes, age range and gender. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Return the caller's current Morfran credit balance. Free.
